---
title: "OASIS pics preparation - R Notebook"
output: html_notebook
---
This notebook serves to
1) read in the overview data for the OASIS pictures
2) divide the pictures by valence (low/middle/high)
3) create stimulus sets for uncertainty study (rating)
4) add a column in the data set with the picname
5) select only pics in the range 2:5 (arousal and valence)
6) elimintate the nudes images

```{r}
#load needed libraries
library(OneR)
library(tm)
library(plyr)
library(dplyr)
library(Hmisc)
```


#########################################################
1) read in the overview data for the OASIS pictures
#########################################################
```{r}
rm(list=ls())
graphics.off()
setwd(dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path))  # sets the directory of location of this script as the current directory
oasis_data <- read.csv('OASIS_mod.csv')
```



#########################################################
3) get a rough overview over the data
#########################################################
```{r}
summary(oasis_data)
```

#########################################################
4) select only pics in the range 2:5 (arousal and valence)
#########################################################
```{r}
reduced_oasis_data <- subset(oasis_data, Valence_mean>=3 & Valence_mean<=5)
fully_reduced_oasis_data <- subset(oasis_data,Arousal_mean>=3 & Arousal_mean<=5)
summary(fully_reduced_oasis_data)
```

#########################################################
6) elimintate the nudes images
#########################################################
```{r}
# # find nudes in data frame
# l <- sapply(colnames(fully_reduced_oasis_data), function(x) grep("Nude", fully_reduced_oasis_data[,x]))
# nude_index <- l$Theme
# #eliminate all rows of nude_index
# no_nudes_oasis <-  fully_reduced_oasis_data[which(rownames(fully_reduced_oasis_data) %nin% nude_index), ] #491 remaining pics
no_nudes_oasis <- fully_reduced_oasis_data[!grepl("Nude", fully_reduced_oasis_data$Theme),]
summary(no_nudes_oasis)
```

#########################################################
6) eliminate redundant images and rename some from same category
e.g. cemetery=funeral=graveyard
#########################################################
```{r}
no_nudes_oasis <- subset(no_nudes_oasis, Theme !='Bored face 1') # being eliminated 
no_nudes_oasis <- subset(no_nudes_oasis, Theme !='Dummy 1') #already out due to valence_mean criterion
reduced_data <- no_nudes_oasis

reduced_data$Theme_mod <- revalue(no_nudes_oasis$Theme, c("Funeral 1"="Cemetery 6", "Graveyard 1"="Cemetery 7","Graveyard 2"="Cemetery 8","Graveyard 3"="Cemetery 9","Graveyard 4"="Cemetery 10", "Angry pose 1"= "Angry face 6", "Angry pose 2"="Angry face 7"))
```

#########################################################
6) find unique names pics (select one per name manually)
#########################################################
```{r}
#remove numbers from Theme variable
reduced_data$Theme_new <- removeNumbers(as.character(reduced_data$Theme_mod))
summary(reduced_data)
length(unique(as.factor(reduced_data$Theme_new)))

# Problem with additional white space in war (scenes) --> remove all white spaces from the strings
reduced_data$Theme_new <- gsub("\\s", "", reduced_data$Theme_new)  
```
#########################################################
2) find unique theme images
#########################################################
```{r}
# look for ambiguous Themes, that share more than one category, e.g. war is person(3) and scences(2)
myvars <- c('Theme_new', 'Category')
my_check_set <- reduced_data[myvars]
my_table <- table(my_check_set)
my_table <- ifelse(my_table>0,1,0)
items_per_category <- colSums(my_table)
my_table <- as.data.frame(my_table)
my_table$Rowsum <- as.data.frame(rowSums(my_table))
to_exclude <- subset(my_table, Rowsum>1)
double_category_themes <- row.names(to_exclude)

newdata <- reduced_data[!(reduced_data$Theme_new %in% double_category_themes),]
summary(newdata)
test_frame <- as.data.frame(table(newdata$Theme_new))


single_image_themes <- subset(test_frame,Freq==1 )
multi_image_themes <- subset(test_frame,Freq>1 )

single_images_df <- newdata[newdata$Theme_new %in% single_image_themes$Var1,]
multi_images_df <- newdata[!(newdata$Theme_new %in% single_image_themes$Var1),]
#save data frames
write.csv(single_images_df,'single_images_df.csv')
write.csv(multi_images_df,'multi_images_df.csv')
# next step outside R: select most prominent item from multi_images_df per theme --> done by two independent raters
```


```{r}
# subset data per category
animals <- subset(newdata, Category=='Animal')
length(unique(animals$Theme_new))

objects <- subset(newdata, Category=='Object')
length(unique(objects$Theme_new))

persons <- subset(newdata, Category=='Person')
length(unique(persons$Theme_new))

scenes <- subset(newdata, Category=='Scene')
length(unique(scenes$Theme_new))
```


#########################################################
2) add a column in the data set with the picname
#########################################################
```{r}
reduced_data$Pic_name <- paste0(reduced_data$Theme,'.bmp')#or .bmp
```

```{r}
#additional: look at median split data
library(ggplot2)
library(OneR)
oasis_data <- read.csv('OASIS_data_reduced.csv')
mymedian <- median(oasis_data$Valence_mean)
oasis_data_pos <- subset(oasis_data,Valence_mean>=mymedian)
oasis_data_pos$Valence_cat_norm <- bin(oasis_data_pos$Valence_mean, nbins = 3,labels=c('low','middle','high'),method='content')

pos <- ggplot(oasis_data_pos, aes(Valence_mean, Arousal_mean)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Valence_cat_norm, shape = Category), size = 5) +
  ggtitle("Groupwise Valence Positive")
plot(pos)

oasis_data_neg <- subset(oasis_data,Valence_mean<mymedian)
oasis_data_neg$Valence_cat_norm <- bin(oasis_data_neg$Valence_mean, nbins = 3,labels=c('low','middle','high'),method='content')

neg <- ggplot(oasis_data_neg, aes(Valence_mean, Arousal_mean)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Valence_cat_norm, shape = Category), size = 5) +
  ggtitle("Groupwise Valence Negative")
plot(neg)
#save the data separately
write.csv(oasis_data_pos,'OASIS_data_pos.csv')
write.csv(oasis_data_neg,'OASIS_data_neg.csv')
```
